testing_requirements.pattern: kebab-case data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and key metrics

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure index.css and all page components (Home.js, Services.js, About.js, Insights.js, Contact.js, Navbar.js, Footer.js) fully adopt the light, ultra-clean white theme tokens. Remove all legacy dark-glass classes (e.g., bg-slate-900, border-slate-800 dark dark-glass styling) and replace with clean white backgrounds, slate typography, hairline slate-200 borders, soft shadows, and periwinkle purple accent highlights. Retain full content architecture and multi-page routing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark background gradients on light theme sections.
Maintain high APCA contrast for text readability on light surfaces.
Ensure generous vertical spacing (py-24 to py-32) and card inner padding (p-8 to p-10).
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
